## Questions from the stands

### How does GLAD-AI-TOR rank AI tools?

Every ranking is computed live from real visitor verdicts across six arenas (voice, LLMs, image, video, coding and music): 76 tools compared, one verdict per person per tool, and nobody can pay for a spot.

### Are there good free AI voice generators?

Yes, most tools in the arena offer a free tier (14 of 15), typically with limited characters per month and fewer voices. Our 'Best free AI voices' shortlist ranks the ones whose free plan is actually usable.

### How does the crowd score work?

Every visitor can cast one verdict per tool (recommend or avoid) with a short comment, once per tool. Scores are smoothed with a Bayesian prior so a tool with 3 votes can't outrank one with 300. Votes are never paid or sponsored.

### Which AI voice is best for YouTube videos?

For YouTube narration you want natural long-form delivery, fast rendering and per-video cost control. See our dedicated 'Best AI voice for YouTube' ranking for the current crowd favorites.
